title: Chronicle World File
description: Location graph, item registry, and player start for the v1 scenario package contract.

start_location.description: ID of the location where the player begins. Must be a key in 'locations'.

locations.description: Map of location ID to Location object. The map key is injected as the location's id at load time.

items.description: Map of item ID to Item object. The map key is injected as the item's id at load time.

id.description: Optional; the loader injects the map key as id. If present it should match the key.

current_description.description: Optional runtime-override description. Usually empty in authored data.

exits.description: Map of direction string (e.g. 'north') to destination location ID.

items.description: IDs of items present in this location.

npcs.description: IDs of NPCs present. Usually empty in authored data; the loader populates this from npcs.json.

locked_exits.description: Names of exits that are currently locked.

id.description: Optional; the loader injects the map key as id.

unlock_target.description: ID of the location exit unlocked by this item, or empty for none.
